description: This file defines the class ThingCommandFactory which creates command objects to interact with the Things service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for constructing SudoRetrieveThing commands, with logging and correlation ID management.

classes.name: ThingCommandFactory
classes.description: A utility final class responsible for creating commands to access the Things service, specifically for retrieving Things with optional cache context and logging.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThing
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrieveThing command for the given EntityId or ThingId, incorporating optional cache lookup context to customize headers and schema version, while logging and generating correlation IDs.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a UUID-based correlation ID for a given ThingId, logging the fallback when no existing correlation ID is provided.
